# dsh-status-rotator
> Give DSH's running status your own voice: **custom phrases, typewriter output, day/night gradients
, danmaku and an optional animated whale tail**. Ships **1534 phrases, 14 theme packs**; choose whic
ptional animated whale tail**. Ships **1534 phrases, 14 theme packs**; choose which packs to enable.
**English** | 中文 · Effects · Install · Reference · Changelog
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin that replaces `Deep diving...` / `深度求索中...` with editable phr
ases while preserving the host's elapsed-time clock.
## Effect preview
### Status text and light/dark gradients
**Phrase rotation · Typewriter · Light/dark gradients · Official whale-tail sway.** Captured from th
e actual plugin in a minimal DSH host, using sample phrases and an enlarged status row. Static previ
ctual plugin in a minimal DSH host, using sample phrases and an enlarged status row. Static preview.
### Whale-tail animations
Reading left to right, top to bottom: **Official sway → Flipping tail → Sway → Twist**. Official swa
y uses its recommended **4-second cycle**; the other three use **0.5 cycles/s**. The icon containers
stay fixed while the contours deform. Static comparison.
Under Appearance → Whale tail, enable both Keep the whale tail and Tail motion, then choose flipping
tail, sway, twist, official original sway, or random switching. All four actions use 150 frames; ex
isting speed settings still determine the cycle duration. Existing configurations without `animation
` keep the flipping tail. The three resampled actions use losslessly packed SVG coordinates, decoded
only when selected. Generation and validation.
| Choice | Behavior |

| Official sway | 150-frame action, recommended speed **one cycle every 4 seconds** |
| Flipping tai

l / Sway / Twist | Fixed speed or estimated tok/s; default level 3 tops out at **1.5 cycles/s** |
|
Random switching | Select an action pool shared by timed switching and optional tool-call triggers |
Speed presets have 2–5 levels; custom tok/s maximums range from 1–10 cycles/s. The official action k
eeps its recommended speed unless you disable that option.
Speed settings, action pools and tool-call triggers.
### Appearance themes and danmaku
**Classic / Neon / Terminal / Candy / Glitch** set the font, glow, animation and gradient together.
Pick a theme, then adjust its individual options. Theme parameters.
Danmaku supports scrolling, top and bottom placement. Optional hover-pause, click-to-copy, phase col
ors and adaptive density are available in Settings. This is a captured frame with enlarged text and
higher opacity for readability. Danmaku parameters.
## Installation
Install from npm through the Desktop plugin manager, or use `dsh plugin add` for Web. Restart the co
rresponding host after the first install.
### Desktop npm walkthrough
DSH Desktop can install directly from npm without cloning this repository. The screenshots below sho
w **DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2** with a Chinese interface; layouts may differ between host versions.
1. Open DSH Desktop, select **Plugins** (插件) in the sidebar, then click **Add plugin** (添加插件) at the
Desktop, select **Plugins** (插件) in the sidebar, then click **Add plugin** (添加插件) at the top right.
2. Enter this in the **Package name or address** (包名或地址) field:

Choose an **Install source** (安装源) suitable for your network. The screenshot uses the Mainland China
mirror. Click **Install** (安装); Desktop downloads the npm package and registers the plugin.
3. Wait for installation to finish. Find `dsh-status-rotator` under **Installed** (已安装) and confirm
that its enable switch is on. Follow any restart prompt; if the settings page has not appeared, full
y exit Desktop, including its tray process, and reopen it.
4. Open the account menu at the bottom left, then **Settings → Status Texts** (设置 → 状态文案). Choose pa
cks or edit phrases. For tail motion, enable **Keep the whale tail** and **Tail motion** under **App
earance → Whale tail**. Settings save automatically; start a new turn to see the status line.
